description.text: The ninth set of the EX series, released on 9 May 2005 around the Game Boy Advance game Pokémon Emerald, with 107 cards, 106 numbered and a secret Farfetch'd. Japan had no matching set: its cards came from Japanese promos, decks and kits, and it brought back some older Trainer cards. It has the new form of Deoxys from Emerald, as Deoxys and Deoxys ex, and it was the first English set with holo basic Energy cards.
